summary: Sleeping and lying remain distinct. ʕam ḥḏoḏe, gab- and s- allow sexual readings in context, but the nonsexual sibling comparison at 29/516 and existing 78/148 preclude treating co-sleeping as inherently sexual. Retain inherited tentative wording pending review.

III sleeping, lodging, feigning sleep and monetary deposit already belong to sense 1. EL 53/55 are not new senses. Direct ruḥi (JTM 5.3/54) varies with b-ruḥi (52/79). Gazelle and goat causees are participant extensions.

I Preterit Intransitive can be projected into future/anterior and refusal contexts. Infectum-wa covers habitual sleeping and irrealis imprisonment; Part act. presents a continuing state. Coreferential l-suffixes occur on Imperativ dmaxlux and Preterit Intransitive daməxle.
The 6/28 Infectum quotation contains subordinate dumxat in addition to Imperativ dmax. This mixed context does not itself require moving an example legitimately illustrating dumxat.
Do not duplicate EL 19/53/55, MM 98, JL 18.7.10, 1/60, 44/161, 75/92 or existing action-noun quotations. Repeated tokens in the inputs retain separate decisions.
The qaṭəl forms can describe an onset, a continuing past state, or a customary sleeping arrangement. An accident follows daməx in 1.21/1043, while Daməxno in 1.50/2380 supplies a state background.

Preterit-wa and Infectum-wa in reduced plural dəmx- are not reliably distinguished by vowel loss alone. Preserve reader assignments provisionally where discourse favours them; compare unreduced Daməxinawo and dumaxwo. No new box is claimed.
Part act. with a copula contrasts with finite daməx in 2.31/5171. Selected full clauses avoid inferring a feminine form from masculine damixo.
Nomen Actionis dmoxo designates sleeping/lodging fees and rooms; dməxoṯo refers to bedtime in 2.4/795. This supports round-1 nominal organization, not a new Infinitiv.
No new light-verb combination or sexual sense is established. Mere sleeping at someone’s house remains I.1.
PrS 74/68 gives a sleeping sparrow in the Turoyo but a wolf deceiving a fox in the translation. Verify edition alignment; no translation quoted from that occurrence.
Confirm tədmixo as III Nomen Actionis versus lexical lodging noun; dmoxo/dmaxto are already named in the entry. Confirm suffix segmentation of dmoxoṯe and locative interpretation of -ayḏa at 10/7.
